fields.name: tagName
fields.label: Tag Name
fields.description: Custom element tag name registered by the remote micro-frontend, e.g. vwr-header

fields.name: scriptUrl
fields.label: Script URL
fields.description: Absolute URL to the remote micro-frontend's main JS module

fields.name: polyfillsUrl
fields.label: Polyfills URL
fields.description: Optional: URL to a secondary JS module that must load and execute before Script URL (e.g. an Angular polyfills.js bundle)

fields.name: styleUrl
fields.label: Style URL
fields.description: Optional: URL to a CSS file to load alongside the remote micro-frontend

fields.name: loading
fields.label: Loading
fields.description: Lazy defers loading until the block nears the viewport (IntersectionObserver); Eager loads immediately to avoid layout shift for above-the-fold instances

fields.name: rootMargin
fields.label: Root Margin
fields.description: Optional: IntersectionObserver rootMargin used when Loading is Lazy, e.g. 200px (default 200px)

fields.name: minHeight
fields.label: Min Height
fields.description: Optional: reserved placeholder height (e.g. 80px) shown before the remote micro-frontend mounts, to reduce layout shift
